push.title: L 2-3 vs Stinging Beez | You: 8.4
push.body:
PhogsToffees, an 8.4 against Stinging Beez. You were a problem for them all night, the good kind.

THE GOOD
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). You were handing out chances like Halloween candy.
+ You and BellyTb1 turned simple passes into goals.
+ 6th straight match at 7.5 match rating. Gold star, no notes.
+ Completed passes 30, up from your usual 23. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Missed tackles 2, down from your usual 6. Pure hustle, and hustle is free.

THE BAD
- 0 of 2 shots on target. Remember this: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands. Next match, nail it.
- Tackles attempted 2, down from your usual 6. Coach's tip: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. We dug that hole together; we'll climb out together.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. The good neighborhood starts at 88%+.
- A one-goal loss (2-3): a single moment decided it. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.

Practice this: Tight angle? Cut it back to a teammate. A better shot beats a first shot.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. If plan A doesn't work, the alphabet has 25 more letters.

Let's do it again tomorrow. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs Stinging Beez | You: 8.4
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.4. If confidence were contagious, you just gave the whole team a cold.

THE GOOD
+ Won 2 of 4 tackles (up from your usual 29%). You knew exactly when to go, and you went.
+ A brace against Stinging Beez. You put it where the keeper ain't. That's the whole trick.
+ 0.8 better than usual. Proud doesn't cover it.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (5). Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.

THE BAD
- 2 goals from 6 on target. Habit to build: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket. It's coming.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Quick one: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. A team result, and it needs a team answer.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 22 (best was PhogsToffees's 36). Start here: Drift into the half-space between their midfield and defense. It's the hardest spot to mark.
- 3 goals conceded dropped you 0.1. Let's patch that.

Before next match: Side-foot for accuracy inside the box; power is for outside it.

BellyTb1, you already know this, but I'll say it anyway: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

That's how it's done. More of that, please. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 2-3 vs Stinging Beez | You: 7.2
push.body:
A 7.2, buddskees. That's a speed bump, not a wall.

THE GOOD
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 22). Teammates trust you with the ball, and you earned that.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 1). Chance creation is generosity with a soccer ball.
+ You and BellyTb1 were on the same page, same paragraph, same sentence.
+ Fewest missed tackles on the team (0). More of that, please and thank you.
+ Shot accuracy 50%, from 0% in your previous match. That's the stuff I want framed.

THE BAD
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Here's what helps: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't. Brick by brick.
- 67% passing (18 of 27, down from your usual 80%). Here's how: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Little by little.
- Their best midfielder posted 9.8 to your 7.2. Let's turn that around by next session.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 2. That's the bit that kept us from winning.
- A promotion match, and we lost it. Nobody carries that alone. We carry it as a team.

Skills corner: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

Hey buddskees, hold onto this one: Believe it, then go do it.

Stay hungry, stay humble. - Coach Lasso
